title: An admin tab left open across an update can charge a question and answer 'did not understand'
what: The AI Assistant's list of things it can do is built into the admin page, but the server uses its own copy, which changes the moment an update goes live. A tab opened before the update keeps the old list. When the server answers with something new, the old page throws that part away and shows 'The AI Assistant did not understand. Say it another way.' The question has already been counted against today's allowance and credits. Nothing in the admin app ever says a newer version is out or asks for a reload, and owners keep the desk tab open all day.
expected: An open admin tab notices that a newer version is live and shows a short 'MettleUp was updated, reload' line (or reloads itself when nothing is being typed), and a question whose answer the page cannot show is not counted.
how_often: after an assistant update while a tab is open, only when the new answer type is used
fix_line: Let the open admin page notice a new version and show a Reload line; do not count a question whose answer could not be shown

title: Festival ideas silently stop after 2028, and Eid stays 'around' even after the moon is seen
what: The festival idea on Today comes from a list of dates typed by hand for 2026, 2027 and 2028 only. From 1 Jan 2029 no festival idea ever shows, with no warning to anyone; no test or reminder fires before the list runs out. Eid dates for 2027 and 2028 are guesses marked 'around', and nothing turns them into the real day once the moon is seen, so the idea can point at the wrong day.
expected: A check warns MettleUp months before the last listed year ends, and Eid dates are confirmed (or the idea dropped) once the real day is known.
how_often: every day from 2029; around each Eid in 2027 and 2028
fix_line: Add a test that fails a few months before the last listed year ends, and a step to confirm each Eid date
